verdict.rationale: Snowflake documents its own scoping model: privileges are granted to roles and roles to users (RBAC). Its SQL API can provision users and roles, so a narrowly-privileged identity for an agent is plausible, and the managed MCP server claims to let agents retrieve data securely. However, the evidence never shows issuing an API credential itself (token, key or OAuth client) scoped to such a role, so the story is only glancingly supported. Missing for 10: documented issuance of agent API credentials (e.g., tokens/keys/OAuth), per-credential scoping or expiry controls, guidance on least-privilege setup for agents or the MCP server, independent or hands-on corroboration.
